note: Four approved island images followed by ten approved laboratory stills. Changes follow script anchors; phrase positions within a narration clip are approximate character-share timings. The final approved lab still is held until a later batch extends the sequence. Audio and manuscript are unchanged.

shots.alt: A remote forest island in the moonlit Atlantic, with tiny research lights near its center.
Descending through moonlit clouds toward the island's small research settlement.
The research settlement and its laboratory surrounded by dense tropical forest.
A closer aerial view of the lit laboratory, homes, workshops and medical facility.

at.line: Deep inside one of those laboratories

shots.alt: Jack sleeps in his chair directly at his laboratory console, with his arms folded and teal diagnostics on the screens.

at.line: Jack sat slumped in his chair

shots.alt: A closer view of Jack asleep at the workstation, his head tilted and arms folded across his chest.

at.line: A warning tone chirped from Jack's console

shots.alt: Jack shifts without waking at the first warning chirp; his console still shows teal diagnostics.

at.line: A warning tone chirped from Jack's console

shots.alt: Jack remains asleep beside his console as the display flashes an amber warning symbol.
Startled awake by the alarm, Jack rolls his chair a short distance backward from the console.

at.line: The warning repeated while Jack rubbed his eyes

shots.alt: Jack leans back toward the amber-warning display while rubbing one tired eye.

at.line: Several windows were opening and closing on their own

shots.alt: Jack watches windows appear on his computer without touching the keyboard.

at.line: Several windows were opening and closing on their own

shots.alt: Jack types urgently at his workstation to open the network monitor.
Jack leans closer and frowns at the network monitor where an unfamiliar connection has vanished.
A red security warning appears on the primary monitor as Jack stares at it, fully awake.
